source.role: secondary source-node and abridged boundary control
source.boundary: TBESH source-node identity can be pinned under the current registry contract. Its own header says brief definitions are guidance and carries an Online Bible permission caution; therefore these gloss strings are retained only as source-boundary evidence and are not sufficient authority for new production Korean derivatives.

targets.boundary: to/toward/into/against/concerning and other relation senses are syntax/context governed; do not flatten to one Korean preposition
relative-pronoun/conjunction and clause-linking functions must remain grammatical/contextual; combinations or derived nodes must not be merged into the base particle without evidence
all/whole/any/each/every/totality varies with construct and quantifier context
Qal come/enter/go and causative Hiphil bring/lead/carry must be separated by morphology; motion senses are not interchangeable
negation scope and constructions such as no/not/nothing/without are syntactic; do not invent lexical senses from translation wording
gender/number/reference, emphatic/discourse function and copular translation effects are context-governed
proper-name identity is primary; heel-holder/supplanter etymology belongs to provenance and must not replace the name headword
male sibling, male relative and compatriot/kin uses require actual relationship context; suffix morphology is separate from lexical sense
bear/give birth/beget, be born, midwife/help-birth and causative/genealogical uses must track stem, gender and syntax
year, age, duration/lifetime and number constructions require context; numerical morphology must not be folded into the lemma meaning
